findings.one_line: The claimed arbitrary-cardinality target-only quotient is not compared theorem-to-theorem with the closest coarsening and categorical-IV results: the note labels Gabriel and Song motivation/notation only, so it never states whether this exact image/right-inverse result is outside, a strict extension of, or a special case of their respective model and inference scopes.

The reduced KL projection is computable, but its novelty is not positioned against Song et al.'s categorical-IV finite-sample KL confidence-region program; the revision must identify the common substrate and the precise new consequence (target-specific quotient and |C|-free calibration/dimension), or narrow the claim.
